title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.05806v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generator mismatch typical of RAG pipelines. This design also amortizes context encoding by reusing precomputed encoder states across queries. On question-answering benchmarks, INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality. Our results demonstrate that attention-based models already possess a retrieval mechanism that can be elicited, rather than added as an external module.

translated_title: 内在检索：基于注意力模型的固有能力
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通常将检索和生成视为两个独立的系统。我们探究基于注意力的编码器-解码器模型是否可以直接从其自身的内部表示中进行检索。我们提出了INTRA（INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention，通过注意力实现内在检索），这是一个框架，其中解码器的注意力查询对预编码的证据块进行评分，然后将这些证据块直接复用为生成的上下文。通过这种构造方式，INTRA统一了检索和生成过程，消除了RAG流程中典型的检索器与生成器之间的不匹配问题。这一设计还通过在多个查询之间复用预计算的编码器状态来摊销上下文编码的成本。在问答基准测试中，INTRA在证据召回率和端到端答案质量上均优于强大的工程化检索流程。我们的结果表明，基于注意力的模型本身已具备可被激发出来的检索机制，而无需将其作为外部模块添加。
tldr: 论文提出INTRA框架，证明基于注意力的模型本身就具备检索能力，可直接利用解码器注意力从内部表示中检索证据并统一检索与生成过程，在问答任务上超越了传统RAG检索流程。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces INTRA, a framework demonstrating that attention-based models possess an intrinsic retrieval capability that unifies retrieval and generation by scoring pre-encoded evidence chunks directly through decoder attention, outperforming strong engineered RAG pipelines on question-answering benchmarks.
